hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start exercising more. I have ADHD.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start exercising more. I have ADHD.

I needed: ONE thing. Tomorrow morning. Under 10 minutes.

Instead I got a color-coded weekly schedule with "phase transitions" and a note about "consulting my physician before beginning any fitness journey."

I closed the tab. Ate a granola bar. Did nothing.

This is the gap nobody talks about. AI isn't bad at advice. It's bad at knowing WHO it's giving advice to.

A person who needs momentum needs different answers than a person who needs a system. A person who gets overwhelmed by options needs different answers than a person who gets bored without them.

Same question. Completely different human on the other end.

BootFile figures out which one you are — how you process information, what actually gets you to move, where you shut down — and bakes that into every response you get.

No more plans built for someone else.

No more closing the tab.
